Un’area dipendente che risponde subito a: An employee area that answers the most frequent questions straight away, ready for user testing.
Jet HR gestisce le paghe di molte piccol: Jet HR runs payroll for many small Italian companies. The employee area is where people check their payslip, request time off, upload receipts and download documents. Today the mobile app is a shrunk-down version of the desktop, and the payslip speaks the language of the payroll consultant. I redesigned both starting from one question: what does an employee really want to know when they open the app?
Concept personale, non commissionato né: Personal concept, not commissioned or approved by Jet HR. People, companies and amounts are fictional. The legal constraints come from research on public sources, used for design purposes only: they are not legal or tax advice. Chi apre l’area dipendente ha quasi semp: People who open the employee area almost always have a specific question. I ranked the most frequent ones and built the home and the payslip to answer those first.
Quanto ricevo, e quando?: How much do I get, and when?
Netto e data di accredito sono la prima: Net pay and payment date are the first thing on the home screen. Net pay stays hidden until you tap the eye.
Perché è diverso dal mese scorso?: Why is it different from last month?
Ogni busta paga dice cosa è cambiato ris: Every payslip says what changed from the previous month, with the line items that explain the difference.
Quanti giorni di ferie ho?: How many days off do I have?
Ferie e permessi in giorni, con le ore c: Holidays and leave in days, with hours as a detail and the estimate at 31 December.
Dove finiscono i soldi tra lordo e netto: Where does the money go between gross and net?
Una barra divisa in tre: quello che rest: A bar split in three: what you keep, pension contributions and taxes.
Le domande raggruppate per tema e freque: Questions grouped by theme and frequency: they set the order of content on the home screen and in the payslip.
Prima di ridisegnare la busta paga ho ve: Before redesigning the payslip I checked what is mandatory and what isn’t. The form is free, the content isn’t.
La busta paga non ha un modello fisso: s: The payslip has no fixed template: it can be reorganised, as long as it contains all the data.
Importi e codici restano quelli ufficial: Amounts and codes stay the official ones: only the way they read changes.
Dati personali protetti per default: lo: Personal data protected by default: the salary stays hidden until you want to see it.
Dal profilo si possono chiedere le infor: From the profile you can request pay information for your own role.
In home ci sono lo stipendio con la data: The home shows the salary with its payment date, time off in days, to-dos and the team’s week. Requests are made from a side panel, without losing the calendar.
Home: il netto resta nascosto finché non: Home: net pay stays hidden until you tap the eye; the payment date is always visible.
Richiesta di ferie: tipo, date, saldo do: Time-off request: type, dates, balance after the request and who in the team is away, in the same panel.
Gli elementi di sistema restano quelli n: System elements stay native, so the app feels familiar straight away. Inside are the same components as the web app: moving from computer to phone, you find the same rows, the same cards and the same buttons.
Nella barra in basso le sezioni usano le: In the bottom bar the sections use Jet HR’s own icons, the same as on desktop: the brand is recognisable everywhere.
Il PDF ufficiale resta il documento lega: The official PDF remains the legal document, but reorganised around questions. In the app, the explained view puts every line item into plain words, with the official name and code alongside. The amounts are the same; the words change.
Busta paga spiegata: cosa è cambiato ris: Explained payslip: what changed since August, where the money goes between gross and net, every line item with its calculation (screen detail).
Il cedolino: riepilogo in alto, poi comp: The payslip document: summary at the top, then earnings and deductions with codes and a short explanation.
Ogni domanda dell’utente ha il suo posto: Every user question has its place in the app, every mandatory item its place in the PDF.
Colori e caratteri vengono dal sito di J: Colours and typefaces come from the Jet HR website. I turned them into variables and styles, then added the components the app needed, each with a desktop and a mobile variant.
Testi, pulsanti principali e card dello: Text, primary buttons and the salary card
Stessi componenti su desktop e mobile: c: Same components on desktop and mobile: moving from computer to phone, you find the same rows, cards and buttons.
Forme coerenti a ogni livello, con pulsa: Consistent shapes at every level, with capsule buttons and soft cards, true to the brand.
La stessa tipografia ovunque, dai titoli: The same typography everywhere, from headings to amounts, including system elements.
I componenti condivisi, ognuno con la va: The shared components, each with its desktop and mobile variant.
Contrasti verificati sui colori del bran: Contrast checked on the brand colours, so amounts and dates read at first glance.
Aree di tocco ampie e azioni sempre nell: Large touch targets and actions always in the same place, on desktop and mobile.
Parole semplici al posto delle sigle, pe: Plain words instead of abbreviations, for people who don’t know payroll jargon.
Usability test con dipendenti su desktop: Usability tests with employees on desktop and mobile, on everyday tasks: understanding how much you get paid and when, explaining a payslip line item, requesting a day off, uploading an expense, finding the annual tax certificate.
Studiare i vincoli di legge prima di dis: Studying the legal constraints before designing changed the project: the form of the payslip is free, the content isn’t. That told me exactly how far I could go.
Rifarei la scelta di usare gli stessi co: I would make the same choice again to use the same components on desktop and mobile: the experience is consistent and the design system stays small.
La prossima volta porterei prima le doma: Next time I would put employees’ questions in front of real people earlier, instead of starting only from public sources.
Usability test con dipendenti veri, veri: Usability tests with real employees, copy review with a payroll consultant, dark mode and Dynamic Type, handoff to developers.
